mapper.select: SELECT id FROM im_conversation WHERE id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'active' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE im_conversation SET last_seq = LAST_INSERT_ID(last_seq + 1), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'active'
mapper.select:
SELECT c.id, c.type, CASE WHEN c.type = 'direct' THEN COALESCE(pe.name, pu.nickname, pu.username, '已离职员工') ELSE c.name END AS name, CASE WHEN c.type = 'direct' THEN COALESCE(pe.avatar, pu.avatar) ELSE c.avatar_url END AS avatar_url, c.owner_id, c.business_type, c.business_id, c.last_seq, cm.last_read_seq, cm.manual_unread_seq, c.last_message_id, c.last_message_at, CASE WHEN lm.status = 'recalled' THEN '[消息已撤回]' WHEN lm.message_type = 'image' THEN '[图片]' WHEN lm.message_type = 'file' THEN '[文件]' ELSE lm.search_text END AS last_message_text, lm.message_type AS last_message_type, COALESCE(se.name, su.nickname, su.username, CASE WHEN lm.sender_id = 0 THEN '系统消息' ELSE '已离职员工' END) AS last_sender_name, GREATEST( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM im_message um WHERE um.conversation_id = c.id AND um.seq > GREATEST(cm.last_read_seq, cm.join_seq) AND um.sender_id != #{userId} AND um.status != 'recalled'), IF(cm.manual_unread_seq > 0, 1, 0) ) AS unread_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM im_message_mention mm JOIN im_message mx ON mx.id = mm.message_id WHERE mm.conversation_id = c.id AND mm.mentioned_user_id = #{userId} AND mm.read_at IS NULL AND mx.status != 'recalled') AS mention_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM im_message mi WHERE mi.conversation_id = c.id AND mi.is_important = 1 AND mi.status != 'recalled') AS important_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM im_conversation_member mc WHERE mc.conversation_id = c.id AND mc.status = 'active') AS member_count, cm.is_pinned AS pinned, cm.is_muted AS muted, cm.is_hidden AS hidden, cm.notification_level, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cm.draft_json, '$.text')) AS draft, cm.member_role, pm.user_id AS peer_user_id, pu.login_date AS peer_last_active_at, CASE WHEN c.type IN ('group') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS can_leave, CASE WHEN cm.is_pinned = 1 THEN COALESCE(cm.pinned_at, c.updated_at) ELSE COALESCE(c.last_message_at, c.created_at) END AS sort_time FROM im_conversation_member cm JOIN im_conversation c ON c.id = cm.conversation_id LEFT JOIN im_message lm ON lm.id = c.last_message_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = lm.sender_id AND su.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_employee se ON se.user_id = lm.sender_id AND se.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN im_conversation_member pm ON pm.conversation_id = c.id AND pm.user_id != #{userId} AND pm.status = 'active' AND c.type = 'direct' LEFT JOIN sys_user pu ON pu.id = pm.user_id AND pu.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_employee pe ON pe.user_id = pm.user_id AND pe.deleted = 0 WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} AND cm.status = 'active' AND c.status = 'active' AND (cm.is_hidden = 0 OR (c.last_message_at IS NOT NULL AND c.last_message_at > cm.hidden_at))
AND c.id = #{conversationId}
AND (cm.manual_unread_seq > 0 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM im_message fu WHERE fu.conversation_id = c.id AND fu.seq > GREATEST(cm.last_read_seq, cm.join_seq) AND fu.sender_id != #{userId} AND fu.status != 'recalled'))
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM im_message_mention fm JOIN im_message fmm ON fmm.id = fm.message_id WHERE fm.conversation_id = c.id AND fm.mentioned_user_id = #{userId} AND fm.read_at IS NULL AND fmm.status != 'recalled')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM im_message fi WHERE fi.conversation_id = c.id AND fi.is_important = 1 AND fi.status != 'recalled')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM im_message ft WHERE ft.conversation_id = c.id AND ft.message_type = 'task' AND ft.status != 'recalled')
AND c.type IN ('group', 'department', 'business', 'announcement')
AND c.type = #{filter}
AND ( c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(pe.name, pu.nickname, pu.username, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(lm.search_text, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(c.business_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM im_message fs WHERE fs.conversation_id = c.id AND fs.search_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) )
AND ( cm.is_pinned < #{cursorPinned} OR (cm.is_pinned = #{cursorPinned} AND (CASE WHEN cm.is_pinned = 1 THEN COALESCE(cm.pinned_at, c.updated_at) ELSE COALESCE(c.last_message_at, c.created_at) END) < #{cursorTime}) OR (cm.is_pinned = #{cursorPinned} AND (CASE WHEN cm.is_pinned = 1 THEN COALESCE(cm.pinned_at, c.updated_at) ELSE COALESCE(c.last_message_at, c.created_at) END) = #{cursorTime} AND c.id < #{cursorId}) )
ORDER BY cm.is_pinned DESC, sort_time DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (cm.is_muted = 0 AND cm.notification_level = 'all') OR m.is_important = 1 OR m.message_type = 'task' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM im_message_mention ma WHERE ma.message_id = m.id AND ma.mentioned_user_id = #{userId} AND ma.read_at IS NULL ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM im_conversation_member cmu WHERE cmu.user_id = #{userId} AND cmu.status = 'active' AND cmu.manual_unread_seq > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM im_message mmu WHERE mmu.conversation_id = cmu.conversation_id AND mmu.seq > GREATEST(cmu.last_read_seq, cmu.join_seq) AND mmu.sender_id != #{userId} AND mmu.status != 'recalled') ) AS badge_count, COUNT(*) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM im_conversation_member cmt WHERE cmt.user_id = #{userId} AND cmt.status = 'active' AND cmt.manual_unread_seq > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM im_message mmt WHERE mmt.conversation_id = cmt.conversation_id AND mmt.seq > GREATEST(cmt.last_read_seq, cmt.join_seq) AND mmt.sender_id != #{userId} AND mmt.status != 'recalled') ) AS total_unread, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM im_message_mention mu WHERE mu.message_id = m.id AND mu.mentioned_user_id = #{userId} AND mu.read_at IS NULL ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS mention_unread, COUNT(DISTINCT m.conversation_id) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM im_conversation_member cmc WHERE cmc.user_id = #{userId} AND cmc.status = 'active' AND cmc.manual_unread_seq > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM im_message mmc WHERE mmc.conversation_id = cmc.conversation_id AND mmc.seq > GREATEST(cmc.last_read_seq, cmc.join_seq) AND mmc.sender_id != #{userId} AND mmc.status != 'recalled' ) ) AS unread_conversations FROM im_conversation_member cm JOIN im_conversation c ON c.id = cm.conversation_id AND c.status = 'active' JOIN im_message m ON m.conversation_id = cm.conversation_id AND m.seq > GREATEST(cm.last_read_seq, cm.join_seq) AND m.sender_id != #{userId} AND m.status != 'recalled' WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} AND cm.status = 'active'
mapper.sql: u.id AS user_id, COALESCE(e.name, u.nickname, u.username) AS name, COALESCE(e.avatar, u.avatar) AS avatar, e.emp_code, COALESCE(e.dept_id, u.dept_id) AS dept_id, d.dept_name, u.login_date AS last_active_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN org_employee e ON e.user_id = u.id AND e.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = COALESCE(e.dept_id, u.dept_id) AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 0 AND (e.id IS NULL OR e.status IN (1, 2)) AND u.id IN #{id}

SELECT , cm.member_role FROM im_conversation_member cm JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = cm.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_employee e ON e.user_id = u.id AND e.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = COALESCE(e.dept_id, u.dept_id) AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE cm.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND cm.status = 'active' ORDER BY FIELD(cm.member_role, 'owner', 'admin', 'member'), name

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN org_employee e ON e.user_id = u.id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 0 AND (e.id IS NULL OR e.status IN (1, 2))
mapper.update: UPDATE im_conversation_member SET last_read_seq = GREATEST(last_read_seq, #{seq}), last_delivered_seq = GREATEST(last_delivered_seq, #{seq}), manual_unread_seq = 0, is_hidden = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'active'
